pages.text: The three heroes fight for Amun: black and red motes swirl round them. Their arena on the ship cannot be broken, and they never leave it. $(l)Beaten, a hero does not die$(): at a tenth of its health Amun's hold breaks, the hero says so, and it goes over to you $(l)with its whole base and army$() (joined to your base when you have one there). The hero stays on its ship.
Each hero's $(l)part of the artifact's key$() stands beside it on the arena. While Amun holds the hero it cannot be broken; once the hero is free, take it.
